zh-CN.polity-traits.small-area.name: 小面积
zh-CN.polity-traits.small-area.description: 陆地领土不超过约 3.74 万平方千米，不含海面和湖面。
zh-CN.polity-traits.centralized.name: 中央集权
zh-CN.polity-traits.centralized.description: 权力集中于中央，倾向整合更广的领土。
zh-CN.polity-traits.city-state-civic.name: 城邦自治
zh-CN.polity-traits.city-state-civic.descripti: 以城市共同体为核心，倾向紧凑领土与海上联系。
zh-CN.polity-traits.decentralized.name: 地方分权
zh-CN.polity-traits.decentralized.description: 地方共同体保有较多自治权。
zh-CN.polity-traits.tribal-kinship.name: 部族宗法
zh-CN.polity-traits.tribal-kinship.description: 政治整合以亲族与部族关系为基础。
zh-CN.polity-traits.nomadic-pastoral.name: 游牧部族
zh-CN.polity-traits.nomadic-pastoral.descripti: 以牧业和流动社群为基础组织权力。
zh-CN.polity-traits.theocratic.name: 政教合一
zh-CN.polity-traits.theocratic.description: 宗教权威构成治理与合法性的基础。
zh-CN.polity-traits.democratic.name: 民主代议
zh-CN.polity-traits.democratic.description: 共同体通过公共参与和代表制度治理。
zh-CN.polity-traits.militaristic.name: 尚武扩张
zh-CN.polity-traits.militaristic.description: 军事组织与战略控制影响国家治理。
zh-CN.polity-traits.dynastic-aristocratic.name: 贵族王朝
zh-CN.polity-traits.dynastic-aristocratic.desc: 统治家族与贵族等级维系政治秩序。
zh-CN.polity-traits.ancestral-ritual.name: 礼法宗族
zh-CN.polity-traits.ancestral-ritual.descripti: 先祖礼法与地方宗族维系共同体秩序。
zh-CN.polity-traits.mercantile.name: 重商海贸
zh-CN.polity-traits.mercantile.description: 港口与贸易网络构成立国的重要基础。
zh-CN.polity-traits.agrarian-realm.name: 农本立国
zh-CN.polity-traits.agrarian-realm.description: 农业腹地构成立国的重要基础。
zh-CN.polity-traits.industrial-power.name: 工业强权
zh-CN.polity-traits.industrial-power.descripti: 工业、矿业和交通网络支撑国家力量。
zh-CN.polity-traits.artisan-craft.name: 矿冶工艺
zh-CN.polity-traits.artisan-craft.description: 工坊、矿冶和林木资源支撑地方经济。
zh-CN.polity-traits.cultural-patron.name: 文教兴邦
zh-CN.polity-traits.cultural-patron.descriptio: 文化中心和知识传承构成立国的重要基础。

en.polity-traits.small-area.name: Small Area
en.polity-traits.small-area.description: Land territory is at most about 37,356 square kilometers, excluding ocean and lake surfaces.
en.polity-traits.centralized.name: Centralized
en.polity-traits.centralized.description: Power is concentrated in a central authority.
en.polity-traits.city-state-civic.name: Civic City-State
en.polity-traits.city-state-civic.descripti: An urban community governs a compact territory.
en.polity-traits.decentralized.name: Decentralized
en.polity-traits.tribal-kinship.name: Tribal Kinship
en.polity-traits.tribal-kinship.description: Political cohesion rests on kinship and tribal ties.
en.polity-traits.nomadic-pastoral.name: Nomadic Pastoral
en.polity-traits.nomadic-pastoral.descripti: Power is organized around pastoral and mobile communities.
en.polity-traits.theocratic.name: Theocratic
en.polity-traits.theocratic.description: Religious authority underpins governance and legitimacy.
en.polity-traits.democratic.name: Democratic
en.polity-traits.democratic.description: Public participation and representation shape governance.
en.polity-traits.militaristic.name: Militaristic
en.polity-traits.militaristic.description: Military organization and strategic control shape governance.
en.polity-traits.dynastic-aristocratic.name: Dynastic Aristocracy
en.polity-traits.dynastic-aristocratic.desc: Ruling families and aristocratic estates sustain political order.
en.polity-traits.ancestral-ritual.name: Ancestral Ritual
en.polity-traits.ancestral-ritual.descripti: Ancestral rites and local lineages sustain communal order.
en.polity-traits.mercantile.name: Mercantile
en.polity-traits.mercantile.description: Ports and trade networks are central to the polity.
en.polity-traits.agrarian-realm.name: Agrarian Realm
en.polity-traits.agrarian-realm.description: Agricultural hinterlands are central to the polity.
en.polity-traits.industrial-power.name: Industrial Power
en.polity-traits.industrial-power.descripti: Industry, mining and transport sustain state power.
en.polity-traits.artisan-craft.name: Artisan Craft
en.polity-traits.artisan-craft.description: Workshops, metallurgy and forest resources sustain the economy.
en.polity-traits.cultural-patron.name: Cultural Patron
en.polity-traits.cultural-patron.descriptio: Cultural centers and knowledge traditions are central to the polity.
